scope: Česko · civilní a trestní řízení (odděleně označené odkazy)

esig_regulation.basis: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183; Act No. 297/2016 Coll. on trust services for electronic transactions (§ 1: regulates matters following the Regulation). § 6(1): acts towards public bodies may be signed only with a recognised electronic signature (uznávaný elektronický podpis).

data_access_basis.basis: A private party needs a lawful basis under GDPR Art. 6(1), for example legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)); data on criminal offences needs official authority or a legal authorisation (Art. 10). A person can request their own data (Art. 15) within the Art. 12(3) period. Act No. 110/2019 Coll. implements the related EU law and follows the GDPR (§ 1).

timestamp_recognition.basis: Art. 41(1): a time stamp is not denied legal effect or admissibility solely because it is electronic or not qualified. Art. 41(2): a qualified time stamp is presumed accurate as to date and time and integrity of the bound data. Art. 42(1) sets the qualified requirements; Art. 24a(6) recognises qualified time stamps across Member States.

evidence_rules.basis: Any means that can establish the facts may serve as evidence; where no method is prescribed, the court decides how to take it. The court evaluates each item and all evidence together at its discretion.
Documentary evidence is taken by reading the document or stating its content, or by showing it to the parties.

Authorities evaluate evidence by inner conviction based on careful consideration of all circumstances. Anything that can clarify the case may be evidence; each party may obtain and present evidence, and evidence is not rejected only because an authority did not obtain it.
The expert receives the necessary information from the file and defined tasks; the expert does not evaluate evidence or decide legal questions.

review_updates.scope: Added trust-service, time-stamp, data-access, evidence-rule and supervisory-authority references from e-Sbírka consolidated texts (OSŘ and TŘ as of 1 November 2026; Acts 110/2019 and 297/2016 as of 1 January 2026) opened on this date. expert_role keeps its earlier check date.
